budget_overview.title: The overview
budget_overview.hint: Here are the budget lines, sorted by budget for the current year. Filter by Type or Paying company, or search directly in Quick filter.

budget_line.title: A budget line
budget_line.hint: Open a line and explore its tabs. Budget, the main tab, shows 4 columns out of 5 possible ones, all set in Administration. The Relations tab links the budget to the items it carries.
budget_line.hintRecord: You are in the record of {{record}}. Explore the tabs. Budget, the main tab, shows 4 columns out of 5 possible ones, all set in Administration. The Relations tab links the budget to the items it carries.

budget_report.title: A report
budget_report.hint: Every report can be set in detail. Explore the filter options. From the results, open the budget lines concerned directly. Export the report as .pdf, .png or .xlsx.

budget_plaid.title: A question for Plaid
budget_plaid.hint: Ask “What are the main savings opportunities in IT OPEX?”

budget_import.title: Your data
budget_import.hint: Try the export to get the data as csv or xlsx. You can use these files as templates to update in bulk or to import new data. Plaid can also help you convert an existing file.

own_company.title: Your company
own_company.hint: A first company was created with the workspace. Check its data and complete it, especially its currency and chart of accounts. If needed, add your own chart in the Charts of accounts view. Create more companies as needed.

own_budget_lines.title: Your budget lines
own_budget_lines.hint: Import your budget file (export first to get the template) or create your first budget line directly.

own_contract.title: A linked contract
own_contract.hint: Create your first contract and, where relevant, link it to the budget line you just created.

own_report.title: Your first report
own_report.hint: Check that the filters follow your entries. Create more lines to enrich the reports!

hint.budget: Invite your colleagues by creating their user accounts. Use the Authentication menu to set up SSO with Entra ID.
hint.cartography: Invite an application owner: create the user, then send the invitation from the row menu.
hint.portfolio: Invite a project manager: create the user, then send the invitation from the row menu.

map_application.title: An application record
map_application.hint: Here is an application record. Explore the properties panel and the tabs to discover every facet of this key object of KANAP.

map_technologies.title: Technologies, end of support and vulnerabilities
map_technologies.hint: What reaches its end of support in the coming months, the source of each date, and the CVEs that affect these technologies.

map_import.title: Your data
map_import.hint: Export the applications as csv or Excel, then use the template to import yours. Go on with the technologies to attach their end of support and vulnerabilities.

own_applications.title: Your applications
own_applications.hint: Import the list of your applications, or create the first one.

own_technologies.title: Your technologies
own_technologies.hint: Link technologies to your applications: KANAP attaches their end of support.

own_assets.title: Your servers
own_assets.hint: Import or create your servers, then link them to applications.

portfolio_request.title: A request and its score
portfolio_request.hint: Here is a request, on its Scoring tab: the criteria and the computed score. Once approved, it becomes a project in one click.

portfolio_import.title: Your data
portfolio_import.hint: Export the project list of the example to see its format, then import yours. Do the same with requests and tasks.

own_projects.title: Your project
own_projects.hint: The project born from the request: owner, dates, team. Your existing projects import as a list.

own_request.title: Your first request
own_request.hint: Create a request, score it, approve it, then convert it into a project.

own_project_budget.title: The project's budget
own_project_budget.hint: Link a budget line to your project in its relations: spending follows.

map_applications.title: The application list
map_applications.hint: Every application of the example, with its criticality, its owner and its company. It is the inventory: filter, sort, search.

map_assets.title: The servers
map_assets.hint: Each server tells where the applications run: environment, site, installed technologies. Open a record to learn more.

own_findings.title: What KANAP found
own_findings.hint: End of support and known vulnerabilities of your technologies, with nothing more to enter.

portfolio_project.title: The project born from the request
portfolio_project.hint: Here is a project born from a request: objective, team, phases, and under Relations the original request, its applications and its budget lines.

portfolio_tasks.title: Tasks
portfolio_tasks.hint: Every task, whether linked to a project, to the budget or standing alone. Try the filters and the search to find the tasks you care about quickly.

portfolio_time.title: The reports
portfolio_time.hint: Seven reports to steer the portfolio: what happened, what is under way, what comes next. The Capacity heatmap sets each contributor's workload against their capacity.

own_tasks.title: The first tasks
own_tasks.hint: Create the project's tasks, assign them, log the time spent.
